final: WITH category_stats AS (SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS line_count, AVG(CASE WHEN spent <> 0 THEN (spent - amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(amount, 0) END) AS avg_relative_overspend FROM budget GROUP BY category), category_average AS (SELECT AVG(line_count) AS avg_line_count FROM category_stats) SELECT AVG(avg_relative_overspend) AS avg_relative_overspend, AVG(line_count) AS avg_line_count, AVG(line_count - avg_line_count) AS avg_count_above_average FROM category_stats CROSS JOIN category_average WHERE line_count > avg_line_count
